children: Australia’s seasonally adjusted dwelling approvals increased 5.1% month-on-month to 17,948 units in September 2026, rebounding from a revised 5.2% drop in the previous month, preliminary data showed.
It was the first expansion since June, with approvals for private-sector dwellings excluding houses rebounding sharply (16.6% vs -21.2% in August) to 6,579 units.
In contrast, private-sector house approvals fell (-5.3% vs. 3.7%) to 10,432 units.

Across the states, dwelling approvals rose in New South Wales (37.3%) and Queensland (28.0%), while declining in Victoria (-28.9%), Tasmania (-25.7%), Western Australia (-8.7%), and South Australia (-3.2%).
On a yearly basis, building approvals fell 0.8%, reversing an upwardly revised 12.1% jump in August.

title: Australia Building Permits Rise for 1st Time in 3 Months
